event_records.description: Priya decides to contact Maple Row Dental to reschedule her Thursday cleaning.

priya.name: Priya
priya.persona_brief:
You are Priya.
Priya has a dental cleaning scheduled for Thursday, but she needs to reschedule due to a work trip. She wants to find a new slot before Wednesday noon.

front_desk.name: Front Desk
front_desk.persona_brief:
You are Front Desk.
The front desk at Maple Row Dental manages appointment scheduling. They have availability information for various slots and can propose alternatives.

resolution.question: Priya needs to move her Thursday dental cleaning because of a work trip. Will she and the Maple Row Dental front desk agree on a new slot by Wednesday noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Priya and the front desk have agreed on a new appointment slot before 2026-08-12T12:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
